_meta.description: Standardised telemetry event contracts for the CulinaryFeed client-side event layer. All events share a common envelope schema. Each event_type extends the envelope with a type-specific payload block.

changelog.notes: Initial event contract definitions for Phase 1.

commonEnvelope.title: CulinaryFeed Common Event Envelope
commonEnvelope.description: All CulinaryFeed telemetry events MUST include this envelope at the top level. Type-specific fields are nested inside the 'payload' property.

event_id.description: Client-generated UUID v4 uniquely identifying this event instance. Used for deduplication in the ingestion pipeline.

event_type.description: Discriminator field identifying the event contract variant. Determines the shape of the 'payload' object.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this event contract, e.g. '1.0.0'. Must match a known version in the event contracts registry.

session_id.description: UUID assigned at feed session initialisation (fact_feed_sessions.session_id). Propagated to all events within the same session.

user_id.description: Stable user natural business key (dim_user.user_id). For anonymous users, this is the device-generated pseudo-anonymous session UUID persisted in localStorage.

client_ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recorded on the client device at the moment the event was emitted. Used for clock-skew detection against server-assigned timestamps.

app_version.description: Semantic version of the CulinaryFeed client application, e.g. '1.4.2'.

platform.description: Client environment context. Populated from navigator.userAgent and Connection API at session start and cached for subsequent events.

device_type.description: Device form-factor inferred from User-Agent string.

network_type.description: Network connection type from the Network Information API (navigator.connection.effectiveType). 'unknown' if API is not available.

viewport_width_px.description: Browser viewport width in CSS pixels at event time (window.innerWidth).

viewport_height_px.description: Browser viewport height in CSS pixels at event time (window.innerHeight).

payload.description: Event-type-specific data. Shape is determined by 'event_type'. See individual event contract definitions below.

IMPRESSION_HEARTBEAT.title: IMPRESSION_HEARTBEAT Payload Schema
IMPRESSION_HEARTBEAT.description: Emitted every 5 seconds while a recipe card remains ≥50% visible in the viewport. Enables sustained-attention measurement beyond the initial binary impression. The heartbeat stream for a given impression is anchored to impression_id.
IMPRESSION_HEARTBEAT.frequencyNote: One heartbeat per 5-second interval. The first heartbeat fires at T+5s after the impression viewability threshold is met. Sequence resets to 1 if the card exits and re-enters the viewport.
IMPRESSION_HEARTBEAT.businessPurpose: Distinguishes brief passive scroll-pasts (0 heartbeats) from genuine viewing engagement (≥3 heartbeats ≈ 15s+ attention). Powers 'true_view_rate' metric in the recipe performance dashboard.

impression_id.description: UUID of the parent impression event (fact_feed_impressions.impression_id). Links all heartbeats for one card-view to a single impression record.

recipe_id.description: Stable recipe business key (dim_recipe.recipe_id). Denormalised for fast ingestion without surrogate resolution.

recipe_sk.description: SCD2-accurate recipe surrogate key (dim_recipe.recipe_sk) at the moment the impression was created.

feed_position.description: 1-based position of the recipe card in the feed at the time the original impression was created. Constant across all heartbeats for the same impression.

heartbeat_sequence.description: Monotonically increasing counter for heartbeats within this impression. heartbeat_sequence=1 fires at T+5s, =2 at T+10s, etc.

cumulative_visible_ms.description: Total accumulated milliseconds the card has been ≥50% visible since the impression start. Monotonically increasing across heartbeats.

current_visibility_pct.description: Percentage of the card area currently in the viewport at the moment this heartbeat fires (0–100). Useful for detecting partial scroll-off states.

card_format.description: Format of the recipe card. Constant across heartbeats for the same impression.

is_above_fold.description: Whether the card was initially above the fold on session load. Constant across heartbeats.

scroll_depth_at_heartbeat_pct.description: Percentage of the total feed list scrolled at the moment this heartbeat fires. Captures progressive scroll depth.

video_play_pct.description: If card_format is 'video_autoplay', the percentage of the video that has been played at heartbeat time. NULL or omitted for non-video cards.

experiment_arm.description: A/B experiment arm identifier if this impression was part of a controlled experiment. Omitted if not in an experiment.

RECIPE_EXPAND.title: RECIPE_EXPAND Payload Schema
RECIPE_EXPAND.description: Emitted when a user explicitly opens/expands a recipe from the feed card to the full recipe detail view. This is a high-intent action and the primary conversion event in the impression-to-detail funnel. A corresponding RECIPE_COLLAPSE event should be fired on dismiss.
RECIPE_EXPAND.frequencyNote: One event per expand action. Should be idempotent — if the same impression_id generates a second expand (unlikely), deduplicate on action_id.
RECIPE_EXPAND.businessPurpose: Powers CTR (click-through rate) calculations, time-to-first-expand distribution, and ingredient interaction prerequisites. Acts as the funnel gate between impression and ingredient/rating/save actions.

impression_id.description: UUID of the impression that preceded this expand action. Enables direct impression → action conversion joins.

recipe_sk.description: SCD2-accurate recipe surrogate key at the time of the expand event.

expand_trigger.description: The specific UI element or gesture that initiated the expand. Used to optimise card layout and CTA placement.

feed_position.description: 1-based position of the recipe card in the feed at expand time. Used for position-bias analysis in CTR calculations.

time_to_expand_ms.description: Milliseconds elapsed between the impression event (viewability threshold met) and this expand event. Measures consideration time before committing to a detail view.

heartbeats_before_expand.description: Number of IMPRESSION_HEARTBEAT events that fired for this impression before the expand. Proxy for attention depth prior to conversion.

card_format.description: Card format at time of expand. Used in format-level CTR analysis.

is_save_state_visible.description: Whether the save/bookmark icon was visible on the card at expand time. Tests whether save affordance visibility affects expand rate.

scroll_velocity_at_expand_px_s.description: Estimated scroll velocity in pixels/second immediately before the expand gesture. Near-zero values indicate the user had stopped to consider the card.

previous_recipe_id.description: recipe_id of the last recipe the user expanded in this session, if any. NULL if this is the first expand. Enables sequential affinity pattern analysis.

detail_section_shown.description: The section of the recipe detail view that was displayed first on expand (default scroll position or deep-linked anchor).

experiment_arm.description: A/B experiment arm identifier. Omitted if not in an experiment.

INGREDIENT_INTERACTION.title: INGREDIENT_INTERACTION Payload Schema
INGREDIENT_INTERACTION.description: Emitted when a user interacts with a specific ingredient within a recipe's detail view or ingredient panel. Supports multiple interaction sub-types: tap (view details), request substitution, add to pantry list, or mark as owned. This event is a direct FK to both dim_recipe and dim_ingredient.
INGREDIENT_INTERACTION.frequencyNote: One event per discrete interaction gesture. Rapid taps within 300ms are deduplicated client-side before emission (debounce).
INGREDIENT_INTERACTION.businessPurpose: Builds the per-user ingredient affinity graph. Powers the substitution engine, pantry-tracking feature, and 'cookable recipes' ranking (filter by ingredients the user owns). The richest signal for understanding cooking intent vs. passive browsing.

recipe_id.description: Stable recipe business key. The recipe in whose context this ingredient was interacted with.

recipe_sk.description: SCD2-accurate recipe surrogate key at the time of the interaction.

interaction_type.description: The specific type of ingredient interaction. 'tap_detail' is the base interaction; all others are derived high-intent actions.

ingredient_position_in_list.description: 1-based position of the ingredient in the recipe's ingredient list (bridge_recipe_ingredient.display_order). Enables position-bias analysis for ingredient interactions.

ingredient_category.description: Category of the interacted ingredient (dim_ingredient.category). Denormalised into the event to avoid dimension lookups in real-time pipelines.

ingredient_section_label.description: Section within the ingredient list this ingredient belongs to, e.g. 'For the marinade'. NULL if the recipe has no ingredient sections.

is_optional_ingredient.description: Whether the ingredient is marked optional in the recipe (bridge_recipe_ingredient.is_optional). Optional ingredient interaction may indicate experimentation intent.

is_common_allergen.description: Whether this ingredient is a common allergen (dim_ingredient.common_allergen). Tracked to understand allergen-awareness behaviour patterns.

substitution_requested_for.description: When interaction_type is 'request_substitution', this field contains the ingredient_id of the ingredient the user wants a substitute for. Typically identical to ingredient_id but may differ in edge cases (e.g. group substitution). NULL for non-substitution interactions.

ui_context.description: The UI surface from which the ingredient interaction was triggered. Differentiates interactions from the full detail view vs. a bottom sheet panel.

time_since_recipe_expand_ms.description: Milliseconds elapsed since the RECIPE_EXPAND event for the same recipe in this session. Measures engagement depth before ingredient interaction.

impression_id.description: impression_id of the feed card that led to the recipe detail view where this interaction occurred. NULL if the user arrived via direct link or search (not from the feed).

scroll_position_in_detail_pct.description: Scroll position within the recipe detail view at the time of interaction, as a percentage (0 = top, 100 = bottom). Correlates ingredient interaction rate with content scroll depth.
